title: Bill Drill: All-Ages Tactical Adventure in Orlando
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Looking for something truly different to do in Orlando? Step into Decision Tactical, the city’s only indoor tactical theme park, and experience the Bill Drill—our most advanced, full-action adventure. You’ll take on movie-style missions across lifelike sets, including home invasion, street, diner, and mall scenarios, where every decision changes your outcome. Guided by professional instructors, you’ll test your aim, reflexes, and tactical thinking in a safe, family-friendly environment. No VR, no live ammo—just pure, unforgettable action that feels straight out of a movie.

This indoor experience combines the excitement of escape games, the energy of laser tag, and the challenge of an obstacle course—all in one tactical theme park.
